Name: Guinea Pigs - New Coop Animal
Author: Field028
Description:
[center][b][size=5][color=#e8913a][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55980/55980-1795525159-1779042488.png[/img][/color][/size][/b][/center]

[b][size=5][color=#e8913a]Description [/color][/size][/b]
Guinea Pigs adds chubby, chatty guinea pigs to Marnie's shop as a new coop animal. They come in 8 coat colours, leave manure every day for compost and fertilizer, give you a little buff when you pet them, and fill the coop with tiny animations and sounds - and they have a few things they like to do together.
[line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Installation instructions[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods (or install it with Vortex).[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The download contains two folders inside "Guinea Pigs" - the content pack and the code. Keep both; they work together.
[line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Main features[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]A new coop animal[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Buy guinea pigs from Marnie once you have the right coop.[/*]
[*]8 coat colours, picked at random. Babies grow up like other coop animals.[/*]
[*]They graze outside like the vanilla animals, and eat hay in the coop at night.[/*]
[/list][spoiler][list]
[*]Price: 4,000g. Needs a Big Coop.[/*]
[*]Coats: ginger & white, black & white, tricolour, cream, Himalayan, agouti, cream Himalayan and split face.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55980/55980-1795527286-11578192.gif[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Produce[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Guinea Pig Manure every day, or a large version from well cared-for guinea pigs.[/*]
[*]Quality stars follow the same rules as eggs.[/*]
[*]Manure also works in the Charcoal Kiln.[/*]
[*]Charcoal Kiln: 1 manure makes 2 coal, 1 large manure makes 3 coal. [/*]
[/list][spoiler][list]
[*]Guinea Pig Manure 60g, Large Guinea Pig Manure 115g.[/*]
[*]Coopmaster helps the stars, like it does for eggs.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55980/55980-1795525932-549093204.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Pellet Composter[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A new machine that turns manure into Fine Compost, an artisan good.[/*]
[*]Put Fine Compost back in to cure it to a higher quality, like cheese in a cask.[/*]
[/list][spoiler][list]
[*]Recipe at Farming level 6: 45 Wood, 10 Hardwood, 1 Copper Bar, 1 Iron Bar.[/*]
[*]Manure makes normal Fine Compost (230g); large manure makes gold-star Fine Compost.[/*]
[*]Curing: normal to silver in 3 days, silver to gold in 4, gold to iridium in 7.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55980/55980-1795525541-1800523119.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Pellet Mixer[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A new machine that mixes manure into fertilizer. Better manure makes better fertilizer.[/*]
[/list][spoiler][list]
[*]Recipe at Farming level 4: 50 Wood, 20 Sap, 1 Copper Bar.[/*]
[*]Makes Basic, Quality or Deluxe Fertilizer depending on the manure's size and stars.[/*]
[*]Deluxe Fertilizer comes from iridium-star large manure, once you know the Deluxe Fertilizer recipe.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55980/55980-1795525548-1717868924.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Petting buff[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Petting your guinea pigs gives you a small buff and a little energy. The more they love you, the better it gets.[/*]
[/list][spoiler][list]
[*]Needs 1 heart or more, and works on each guinea pig's first pet of the day.[/*]
[*]Each day the whole farm gets one of: Luck +1, Speed +1 or Max Energy +30.[/*]
[*]The buff lasts longer the more hearts the guinea pig has, and petting more guinea pigs adds time (up to 7 minutes).[/*]
[*]Each first pet also restores a little energy (more hearts, more energy, up to 50 a day).[/*]
[*]It doesn't stack with a food buff of the same stat - you keep the better one.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55980/55980-1795524932-4185955.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Animations[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Idle breathing, sniffing and blinking (also while walking), and breathing while they sleep.[/*]
[*]Lots of little guinea pig moves - pet them and see.[/*]
[/list][spoiler][list]
[*]Popcorn hops when you pet them - and now and then by themselves, setting off the guinea pigs nearby.[/*]
[*]Face washing, loafing with a little butt wiggle, wheeking, a longer eating animation, and zoomies outside.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55980/55980-1795524943-1691926474.gif[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Things they do together[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Guinea pigs that live together sometimes do things together. Adults and babies too.[/*]
[/list][spoiler][list]
[*]Nose boop - two guinea pigs walk up nose to nose, sniff, and a heart pops up.[/*]
[*]Grooming - one licks the other's ear while it closes its eyes and leans in.[/*]
[*]Cuddle pile - two loaves side by side.[/*]
[*]Follow-the-leader train - with 3 or more guinea pigs, one leads and the others follow in a line, chutting as they go.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55980/55980-1795524959-226096296.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Sounds[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Their own wheeks, chirps, chuts and squeaks, with adult and baby versions.[/*]
[*]Only guinea pigs on screen are heard, sounds never pile up, and the game's "mute animal sounds" option works.[/*]
[*]Hungry wheeking (optional): guinea pigs can call for hay when the troughs are empty. Off by default (just the occasional wheek, like other animals).[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=5][color=#e8913a]Compatibility[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Adds a new animal - doesn't replace chickens, rabbits or any other animal.[/*]
[*]Works with UI Info Suite 2: the buff text above your head moves up so it doesn't cover the Exp text.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: every player needs the mod installed. Animations and sounds are synced from the host.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Config[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Change settings in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional).[/*]
[*]Hungry wheek: Occasional (default), Some, Many or All.[/*]
[*]Guinea pig sound volume.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Shout outs[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Pathoschild, for SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]The Stardew Valley Wiki and its editors.[/*]
[*]Guinea pigs everywhere - this mod was made by someone who just really loves them.[/*]
[/list]
